title: Types Of Theology
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is the only book that is the Word of God.
The Bible - The Bible is the only book that is the Word of God.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the product of theological complications arising from the encounter between Africans and the Western missionary activities.
African Christian Theology is the product of theological complications arising from the encounter between Africans and the Western missionary activities.
Fill in the blank: ______ is one of the largest denominations in the world, with the members cutting across all races, gender and different social status that characterize the human society.
The Roman Catholic Church is one of the largest denominations in the world, with the members cutting across all races, gender and different social status that characterize the human society.
fib: ______ is a "realistic Christology" that deals pragmatically with problems of the now.
The Pentecostal Christology is a "realistic Christology" that deals pragmatically with problems of the now.
______ is the fastest growing movement in present day Christendom.
Pentecostalism is the fastest growing movement in present day Christendom.
